title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

unknown.title: The Legend of the Northern Blade

description:
For decades, the brave warriors of the Northern Heavenly Sect fought to keep the world safe from the evil Silent Night. But when the fourth generation leader is accused of colluding with the enemy, he is forced to disband the sect and commit suicide to protect his son, Moo-Won. With no family and allies left, Moo-Won leads a dreary life under close surveillance... until a surprise attack from the Silent Night gives him a chance to escape to the mountains. There, the young warrior trains to master the fighting techniques of his predecessors, before the mysterious disappearance of a loved one brings him back to the mainland. Follow Moo-Won as he embarks on a journey to avenge his father’s death and take down the villains who threaten to plunge the world into darkness! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

description:
The marchioness Shuri Von Neuschwanstein is no stranger to hardship: her husband dies when she’s still a teenager, leaving her to manage his lands and raise his semi-grown children herself. Her stepchildren never warm up to her, and other nobles disparage her behind her back. Years later, however, it seems her efforts have finally paid off: her eldest stepson is to be married and take over the estate, freeing her of many responsibilities. But shortly after learning the cruel truth that she’s not invited to his wedding, she dies and wakes up on the day of her husband’s funeral seven years earlier! If Shuri is to live these seven difficult years all over again, she’s going to do things differently. Can she write her own fairy tale ending this time around?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Whale Star: The Gyeongseong Mermaid
description:
The year is 1926 in this retelling of Hans Christian Andersen’s “The Little Mermaid”, and Joseon (present-day Korea), is under colonial Japanese rule. Su-A Heo is a handmaiden who spends her days working and swimming in the sea. Her work is her whole life, until one day, when she discovers a wounded independence fighter named Ui-Hyeon Kang washed up on the shore. She nurses him back to health, only to lose her ability to speak in a botched murder attempt by Ui-Hyeon’s comrade, Hae-Su Song. As she travels to the capital, Gyeongseong (present-day Seoul), to get revenge, she finds herself growing more and more intertwined with a strange, brave new world and the people within it.

(Source: WEBTOONS)

description:
Every novel has the usual cast: a gorgeous heroine, handsome boys vying for her attention, and a homely best friend at the heroine’s side. Dan-I, an ordinary student and avid reader of internet novels, is all too familiar with these tropes. But she never imagined that one day she’d wake up at the center of one herself! Her new fictional world is complete with a beautiful best friend named Yeo- Ryeong, and four impossibly good-looking boys who all happen to be in her class. Dan-I is determined to stay out of the way and not get involved in the twists and turns of the plot. But is she really just the sidekick -- or is Dan-I actually the leading lady? Anything is possible in the world of a novel! 

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

description:
It’s 1935 in Gyeongseong, and struggling artist I-Ho Yun has been commissioned by the reclusive, elderly Madam Jeong-Hwa Song to paint a portrait. Madam Jeong-Hwa Song allows I-Ho to set eyes upon her -- an unprecedented event -- and standing before him is a young woman. But why does she ask him to paint an elderly version of her? “Don’t finish the portrait.” Tucked between the previous artist’s paint tubes is an ominous letter. I-Ho learns that no artist has left Madam Song’s abode alive or of sound mind. Just what is she hiding and what will happen if I-Ho finishes the portrait? 

(Source: WEBTOON, edited)

title: Secret Alliance
description:
Eun Si-An, otherwise known as Shanshan by her good friend Hyunee, is popular with all the girls at school. Which would be great if she swung that way, but she doesn’t. It just happens that she’s terrified of men, and her mother is obsessed with protecting her from all men. And suddenly, Yu-Ri, the prettiest girl at school, has admitted to Si-An that she has feelings for her. Now Yu-Ri won’t stop following Si-An around, which would also be fine by Si-An, except it seems like Yu-Ri wants Si-An all to herself... and who knows how far she’ll go to make sure that happens. 

(Source: Lezhin, edited)

description:
Born into a family of handsome, wealthy, and well-educated alphas, Woo-Young always expected he would be the same. Come to find out, he was the odd man out as the lone omega, and not even a perfect one at that. To compensate, Woo-Young goes through life pretending to be a beta, but when he begins to experience hormone imbalances, irregular heat cycles, and a distinct lack of control over his impulses, his lowly recessive omega status becomes impossible to ignore. That’s when he meets Kyung-Ju, a powerful and successful dominant alpha who can turn him into a true omega, and also makes him weak in the knees. Now, Woo-Young must use every tactic there is to court Kyung-Ju and make the brooding alpha his very own. 

(Source: Tappytoon)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 23 side story chapters.*

description:
"Could this all perhaps be Hwayeon's dream? Or did Yeonu create this fantasy world in her head to escape her harsh reality?" Hwayeon Ryu, without knowing the cause, falls into a coma at the age of six. Then after 12 long years of her father, Chung Ryu's persistent attempts, she finally opens her eyes. As she wakens from her prolonged sleep, she realizes she not only has her memories but has the memories of someone else's life, Yeonu Lee. Though startled at first, as time passes, she manages to adjust to her new life. Then one day, in hope to have lunch with her father, she pays a visit to the palace. But she ends up taking the wrong turn and finds herself in front of the notorious beast, crown prince Muyeong... The story unfolds then, when the soft and delicate flower Hwayeon meets the arrogant and fearless beast, Muyeong. 

(Source: Pocket Comics) 

*Note: Includes 32 extra chapters.*

description:
Hye-Ji is a famous SNS star with over 100,000 Instagram followers. Due to her popularity, Hye-Ji has received many confessions, but despite that, she doesn't really have much dating experience. One day, Hye-Ji received an invitation to go out on a date with another popular SNS star whom she secretly admired. On the day of the long-awaited date, Hye-Ji couldn't stand the subtle light coming from the karaoke bar, so she decides to use her feet to take a selfie. But due to an accident, Gi-Seong, who was a part-timer at that time, ended up seeing her in an embarrassing position. 

After such a disastrous date, Hye-Ji decided to end her first-ever relationship. However, on her first day at school, she meets Hae-Ri, the person who gave her that embarrassing memory!

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

unknown.title: เจ้าหญิงเบียทริซ

description:
As the last princess of Elpasa, Beatrice could only watch as the Nosteros Empire destroyed her homeland. Now forced to live as a slave in the empire, the former princess adopts the name Chloe to hide her past and start anew. But when Duke Alessandro, the very man who destroyed Elpasa and attempted to kill Beatrice, takes notice of Chloe for her intellect and charm, a hide-and-seek romance between a princess in hiding and a wicked duke unfurls.

*Source: Tapas*

----

Princess Beatrice of Elpasa can do nothing but watch helplessly as Duke Alessandro of the Nosteros Empire invades her country and strips her of her status—but nobody could’ve have predicted to take to the hard labor like a fish to water. Having grown up as the commoner Chloe, the former princess is quick to reclaim her birth name and chop off her long locks, eager to get a fresh start to her second life. Her past is hard to escape, however, as her intellect and charm catches the eye of Duke Alessandro himself! Will she be able to hide her identity as Beatrice, or is she fated to meet her end by his sword?

*Source: Yen Press, Vol. 1*

title: Return Survival
description:
In a post-apocalyptic world ruled by hordes of flesh-eating zombies, law and order have fallen by the wayside, and it's every man for himself. Luckily, Yo-Han has the unique advantage of having gone through this once before. After traveling back in time to six months before the initial outbreak, he gets to work amassing supplies and gearing up to take on any undead creatures. But the living dead aren't all he has to worry about, with bandits, gangs, and rogue factions cropping up all around to inflict terror and seize control. And when the timeline stops playing out the way he remembers, Yo-Han realizes that his prior knowledge will only take him so far. Now, the only way for him to make it out alive is to conquer both the living and the dead.

(Source: Tappytoon, edited)

*Note: Chapter count includes a prologue and 15 side stories.*

description:
*“Ba-woo, will you be my mate?”*

Deep within the remote mountains—with the peaks and fields as his only companions—lived Ba-woo: an earnest young woodcutter of striking beauty who spent his days brewing makgeolli and tending to his crops.
He had prayed and pleaded endlessly to the Mountain Spirit to grant him a worthy mate,
but the only thing that ever answered his prayers was the trail of hoofprints left by a thieving roe deer that had raided his precious fields!

Then one day, slumped beside a shattered makgeolli jar, Ba-woo discovered an unconscious, naked man—a figure with dark skin, rippling muscles, and a pair of jutting fangs that were strangely alluring.

In that very instant, he realized the truth:  
At long last, the Mountain Spirit had sent him a mate!

*“Come on, let’s hurry home and mate!”*  

*“M-mate?! I mean... isn't it a bit too soon for us to be mating?”*  

*“Or would you rather do it right here? I’m certainly up for it.”*

title: Show Me Some Love!
description:
Eden Jang's often been mistaken for a foreigner or a Korean who's lived abroad due to his appearance. One day, on his way to school in a new neighborhood he's just moved to, a 10-year-old Eden is confronted by foreigners who seem to think he's just like them. But being also lost and tired, he gets flustered and goes into a state of panic. It's then when a total stranger, Sarang, shows up and saves him. Coincidentally, Sarang lives next door to Eden, and the two become close like real brothers. To Eden, Sarang is the older brother-like figure he looks up to. He tags along Sarang wherever he goes, just like a puppy would its owner. But as Eden grows older, he realizes his feelings for Sarang were far more than just brotherly love. Unable to suppress his feelings any further, Eden ends up kissing Sarang on a live internet channel when he's drunk. The dynamics between the two change, and Eden becomes bolder, making sure Sarang knows how he feels. Will Sarang reciprocate his love? Is Eden merely like a younger brother to Sarang, or does he also have feelings for who?

(Source: POCKET COMICS)

title: Cross the Line
description:
Since the day she was born, Ha-Yeon's life has been nothing but a series of misfortunes. Not only did she grow up with abusive parents, but she also received a 12-year prison sentence for their murder when she was 16. And as soon as she gets out of prison, she's dragged away to the infamous Supernova Capital because of her parents' massive debt. But when she faints there from exhaustion, a surprising someone takes pity on her— the director of the loan company himself! Finding allies along the way, Yewang sets out to fight back against his bullies and the school’s strict hierarchy.

description:
I became the wife of a man who already had a lover.
So, I should do my best to help him remain faithful to her, right?

But how did I end up destroying the bed with him on our first night together...?

\*\*\*

Aristine is a royal princess who's been confined all her life, as she is highly disfavored by the emperor.
But the truth is, as the possessor of the \[Royal Sight\], she can see the past, present, and future.

The emperor sends her off to die in a political marriage arranged with the prince of their enemy country, rumored to be a bloodthirsty savage, but...
Her soon-to-be husband, the so-called "savage," is far more normal than the rumors suggest.

"Still, he's taken, so he's off-limits for me. I'll just focus on making lots of money from now on!"

Will Aristine be able to fulfill her dream of living a luxurious, wealthy life?
Or will she be able to kill two birds with one stone and win over her husband as well?

(Source: Korean publisher, translated)

title: The Planned First Kiss
description:
When she came back to life, she became an extra in a novel. Living in the palace of the cruel emperor’s as a villainess concubine, her throat was cut because she tormented the heroine! 

What should I do at this moment? 

Get close to the heroine? No. 

Get close to the male lead? No, not that either. 

Survive to have long and fine life? All of it! 

Three years have passed since she lived peacefully as an outsider of the Imperial City. As long as the novel ends with a happy ending, she thought she could be free. 

*“Who are you…”* 

*“All this time…”* 

…What? 

*“I’ll listen to you.” 

“Huh?” 

“I’ll listen to whatever you say. Can we live together then?”* 

The servant who came into my easy life. 

I live a happy life with him. Sometimes he’s a kind servant, and other times, a dear friend…The problem is, I can’t seem to take my eyes off him when he smiles saucily and flirtatiously with those red eyes. 

…Is it because of my feelings?

titles.title: 1st Kiss Was Intentional, The First Kiss Was Intentional

unknown.title: The Villainess Wants to Be a Sidekick

description:
Why do they keep killing him off? What did he ever do wrong? 

A fan of the otome dating game finds that her ultimate bias, Rumins, ends up dead in every route but one. 

After completing all routes of the game, a mysterious voice asks for her wish. Furious and choked up, she shouts to save her ultimate bias and to give him a happy life. 

 

Waking up as Senepin, the villianess who harrasses the main character, she enjoys her dream where she could talk to Rumins, alive and well. 

That is, until, ‘Senepin’ realizes that her new self was not a dream. 

Senepin remembers that the only time Rumins survived his damned endings was when he ended up together with the female lead, Belkina. Realizing this, she makes it her utmost priority to get Rumins and Belkina together. 

But for some reason, Rumins seems more interested in Senepin than the original female lead. Will ‘Senepin’ be able to save Rumins?

description:
I’m Selena, a daughter born to a family well-known for their fertile women. I was all but sold off in a marriage to a sickly duke whose life hung in the balance, all for the sake of producing an heir for his family. They provided me a medicine purported to aid in pregnancy, and the astrologist advised me good days for sleeping together, but... there was no child. 

*“So, are there any signs of pregnancy?”
“Ah, I-I'm sorry.”
“You’re useless. What luck do you think won you the position of the duke's wife?”*

I couldn't say a word. 

*"No, excuse me. I only have to look at the sky to pluck a star. That's how I attained this position.\*"*

\*Metaphor: Lit. Plucking a star from the sky: something that's difficult to get/achieve)

(Source: Kakao, translated)

*Note: A promotional one-shot for the homonym novel.*

As time passed, Baek Cheon, aware of her engagement to the emperor of Daeju, decides to run away with cries for freedom and true love. In the end, Ye Hwa was made to enter the palace in princess Baek Cheon's stead.

Using their indistinguishable looks, the two of them switched places and entered the palace together after many troubles. However, in contrast to the extravagance, the palace is filled with dark secrets, and they are now embroiled in its events.

The dangerous double life of Ye Hwa, who switches back and forth from a maid to a princess, just how will it end...?!

title: Gamyeonmu
description:
"Sometimes, your future gets decided by just one moment."

The whole kingdom of Jesús fell into a state of shock after hearing the news of Queen Mary Trizia’s Suicide. While everyone praised Mary Trizia for being an excellent queen, her older twin brother, Rafael Evans, was most suspicious of her death.

*"It can only be you. No one else can save me other than you."*

These words and the image of his sister screaming those words while approaching him bare-footed remained in his head. Rafael ventures out in search after his relatives for the first time in his life, to attend Mary’s funeral. But in the place where they found Mary’s body, Rafael finds a note…

*“Lift up your face.”*

Wanting to find Mary's killer, Rafael disguises himself as the new queen consort, Anne-Mary La Shore, and meets the king ‘Ivry.’

That moment marked the start of an unprecedented fate. The unexpected end of his sister who wasn’t like her younger self, and who he believed would find happiness…

What was the ‘hell’ that his sister dropped into? And what will change after Rafael and Ivry meet?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

description:
Perdi, known widely throughout the continent, is a very famous author of adult novels. But Perdi’s true identity is actually Vivian, the Imperial Night Librarian. 

Vivian sends over the 4th draft of her latest novel to her publisher to be reviewed, but her work is criticized because the way she writes hetero sex scenes isn’t erotic at all. 

“What, so you’re saying I’ll only know what sexual relationships are like after I experience it myself? But what can I do when I’m bound to a chastity contract?” 

Unfortunately for Vivian, she had to sign a chastity contract in order to be hired as an imperial servant, and has been forced to remain a virgin ever since. Worse still, only a member of the imperial family could break the contract... but Vivian only has eyes for Ray, a mysterious man who visits the library every night. 

But as it turns out, Ray is the imperial archduke and the emperor’s brother! One day, he approaches her with a sweet offer that she can’t resist…

description:
I became a side character who was the younger sister of the male lead in a martial arts novel. Not only that, but I was sold off to the demonic cult for my family's sake where I met the young master, Hyuk Dojin. 

He would asked me everyday if I wanted anything from him and my response would simply be a no. However, despite my answers, he would gift me many things like sending money to my family, buying me jewels, and giving me ivory from the southern lands and silk clothing. Whenever he asked if I wanted anything else, I would only shake my head in response. 

Normally, he would understand and turn away, but today, he gazed at me vacantly. When I approached him, asking what was wrong, he laid his head on my shoulder lifelessly. 

"Why do you lie to me every time?" 

He lifted his hand slowly and grabbed my wrist. 

"Why won't you tell me..." 

He spoke desperately, as though he would fall apart at any moment.

title: Appa, Jeoneun Amugeotdo Haji Aneulgeyo

unknown.title: 爸爸，我什么都不会做的 (Pre-serialization)

description:
*Just as your birth did not inspire me, so your death won't mean anything to me.*

Jaina reincarnated as a supporting character who was born as mixed blood of human-dragon and died miserably after being neglected. She is branded as an unclean entity and was abandoned by the dragons.

And the first time she met her father, the lord of the tower, Diamide, he just looked at her coldly, as though he didn't feel any sense of intimacy to his daughter as described in the original.

"Is that the one you called my daughter?"

Jaina flinched as he approached and lowered her sight.

"Blue eyes... but that's not a proof that she's my daughter. You could have brought me a child born with another human."

And so he went back leaving her alone and Jaina was living in the shabby warehouse of the tower.

Rather than making vain efforts to get into the eyes of his father, the lord of the tower, she decided to have a small luxury that she had never experienced even in her previous life before her death.

"You don't have to think of me as your daughter. I won't call you father either."

"..."

"Tower's lord?"

So is the father, who should've been indifferent, starting to get obsessed? Father, can you just leave me alone?

description:
I woke up in this new world as Diana Gundal, the youngest daughter of a feudal lord. But hey, that’s great news! That means I can live my life pampered from head to toe right? 

Wrong! Everyday I’m living like a maid to help out with the household. What’s even worse is that I neither inherited the old Diana’s memories nor her knowledge of the language. I’m basically starting from scratch… I thought I would live the rest of my life like this until the Emperor came to visit our small village. 

BOOM! Oh lord, he is so handsome! I’m now so thankful I’m living under the same sky as him. I will work hard to get closer to him as his new number one fan!

description:
*Note: This is a promotional oneshot.*

“The Blessing of Heaven”, “A Prodigal Genius”, “Edenberg’s Dog”

To win the love of her adopted parents, Elena dedicated her skills to the Edenberg name. If anything posed to harm the family, Elena would even kill the people she loved. In the end, Elena’s “family” chose to sacrifice her. No longer having the will to live, Elena’s dying wish was to destroy the Edenberg family name. Time reset and Elena now has a chance to do just that with the help of the mysterious Emperor who heard her wish.

————————————

A family not connected by blood but with ink. I do not desire these abilities of mine. I only want love from them however, they cruelly used everything I had and abandoned me at the end.

I was offered as a sacrifice.  
“Those eyes.”  
Before death approached after I was sacrificed, I met him.  
“You have no will to live.”  
He breathed in the scent from my neck as if it was the most fragrant thing.  
“Your last wishes, child.”

Those were the last words I heard in this life. I thought that moment was extremely awful. If only I was allowed to live one more time. Then. This time I will throw you people away first. Like a miracle, I returned to the past.

“I come to pick you up.”  
“……”  
“Really, it has been a while, isn’t it?”  
I met him again.

description:
I became the main character who beats around the bush in an angsty romance fantasy novel. The role of the heroine who gets thrown by the male lead and is ignored by her best friend. It can’t go this way! I have to change the original route by all means. 

*“Please employ me as your support.”* To survive, I decided to stick to the antagonist, the crown prince, of the original plot. However, this man is in no way going as planned. To add, even a weird rumor is going around. That I and Palus are lovers, with plans of a wedding ahead. 

*“We’re not lovers. It’s just me who cannot live without her.”* 

Huh? What is this guy saying right now! Why is he adding fuel to the fire! *“Crown Prince, the King said...”* What of these bad rumors, this much I expected once I decided to be the Crown Prince’s support. *“You have fallen for Noo-nim and that you cannot come to your senses.”* 

However, that wasn’t true. False rumors must have morality! In fact, he likes men! *“That being blind to jealousy, you broke the wrist of a man, getting close to Noo-nim on spot.”* 

“……” No, I mean that’s not completely untrue. But, that might not be the reason… 

*“I also heard rumors that you might officially marry Noo-nim soon.”* 

“……” No. That’s never true! 

***Note:*** This is a one-shot promotional manhwa for the novel of the same name.

title: 99% in Love - Extended
description:
School is hard, but love is even harder - especially when you’re as popular as Lee Doha. Fortunately for him, his best friend Seo Joon has been by his side to ward off his worshippers since they were kids. Unfortunately for him, however, Joon has also been harboring a soul-crushing love for Doha since the day they met. So when the two enter high school, Joon will do whatever it takes to keep Doha safe from the swarms of admirers that hover around his every move. Under the pretense of keeping him safe from others’ affection, he takes the opportunity to realize his dream of a relationship with Doha – even if it comes in the form of a contract with its own set of terms and conditions. As the two dive deeper into dating, will Joon and Doha add up to be a 100% match? Or is Joon destined to live in love purgatory, always giving 99% of his heart to his one true love? 

(Source: Lezhin)

description:
***Note:** Promotional oneshot for the novel.*

Princess Apollonia is known to be frail and dim-witted, always getting her suitors stolen by her own attendants. However,  that is nothing but a façade, a pretense she has kept up ever since she witnessed her own father killing her grandfather and even her mother to take over the throne. Her objective has always been one: to reclaim what is rightfully hers.

Does Apollonia have what is takes to brave the perils on the path to the throne?

[Promotional Webtoon/Novel](https://page.kakao.com/viewer/%EB%91%90-%EC%96%BC%EA%B5%B4%EC%9D%98-%ED%99%A9%EB%85%80/%EB%91%90-%EC%96%BC%EA%B5%B4%EC%9D%98-%ED%99%A9%EB%85%80-%ED%94%84%EB%A1%A4%EB%A1%9C%EA%B7%B8/53385595)

***Artist(s):**  
Cover Artist: Socha *

“Your Majesty, please call off my engagement with Her Highness, Princess Apolonia. I fell in love with Adriene Rhys.”

Six engagements, six breakups. The princess' fiancés always have an affair with her maids!

“I don’t want to marry a prince, I want to live with you, Father.”

“How useless. Leave!”

Apolonia, a princess who is known to be weak and stupid. However, she has a hidden side to her...

“Because the throne is not easily obtained, my father spent 10 years trying to kill my mother and the Emperor.”

Apolonia grinned, while her red eyes shone brightly. Usurping the throne. Her goal was clear and she never shook.

'I want to live with my father... To be precise, I want to live where my father sits. Just wait, Father. Your daughter is on her way... to get back everything that was stolen from her.'

Note: This is a promotional oneshot.

There hasn't been a queen like this before!

The strongest monarch in Babel's history called the God of War, God's Daughter, Aroha Fenril Astrofortus! After her return from concluding a seven-year war, she finds that those bastard nobles have prepared a bothersome trap…

'Your Majesty, you must choose a husband and continue the royal family's bloodline!'

She wants to throw all of that away, but in consideration for the royal bloodline, she does have to get married. On top of that, she's receiving a crazy amount of proposals from those that are vying for Babel's second highest position.

The husband candidates chosen by the Grand Chamberlain on special orders! The genius that is Babel Academy's youngest professor in all history, an optimistic national guard, Babel’s General and the Queen’s reliable comrade, and the young hero of Babel's political world, the most beautiful man.

There is a doctor named Ji-soo who people say has the hands of a perfect surgeon, but in fact, what no one knows is she has god-like eyes that tell the difference between who will die and who will live. She then meets someone who needs to be operated on but finds it’s something she couldn’t do, even with her ability. Meanwhile, Yaksa, who is being chased as a fugitive, is planning on buying land he had been collecting with someone. There, Yaksa meets Ji-soo, who is guarding the land next to his own and at the request of Ji-soo, finds some special beads. Ji-soo, who said she would give the land for free for the sake of finding the beads, leaves town with the beads, and keeps them in her clothes until her return. One day, Ji-soo goes into the O.R. and unexpectedly experiences the patient’s death. A car appears in front of the shocked doctor. Ji-soo uses the beads that were held by the Yaksa in the middle of the night.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4306135), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54364065)

title: Dog's World
description:
A down on his luck, middle aged store clerk with nothing in the form of job prospects or a future, suddenly gets the chance to date the girl of his dreams when he falls into a world where animals are the owners of the world and humans are their pets! How will he get back home?

Siwan lives beyond his means, job searching and barely able to survive on his part time convenience store salary; his whole life has been very grim, without excitement, purpose or even luck… but everything is about to change. On this fateful day Siwan finally has a conversation with a beautiful girl who he has tried to confess to but couldn’t find the courage to tell her about his crush. During the talk, she actually tells him first of her own feelings for him and the two decide to get a drink; seemingly changing Siwan’s luck for the better. After a night of fun and romance, the two walk back together drunkenly and fall into an alley somewhere so they can sleep it off, all the while smiling and dreaming of his new good fortune.

Soon after, Siwan wakes up to a loud noise and realizes he has awoken in a world where animals and humans’ roles have been reversed! As a human he must now live as a pet and serve dogs and cats who treat him as property. His only hope and motivation is escaping this crazy world, in hopes of seeing the girl he loves gain.

The Grand Duchy of Hessenguard lost its master. title: Heroina
description:
A young boy admirer of his planet’s greatest heroine gets a chance to take on her form when his heroine suffers an accident breaking her body up into pieces.

Sapana has grown up admiring her childhood heroine, Heroina, who saved him when he was just a child. One day, Heroina, who has been protecting the planet for what seems like a long time, suddenly leaves it saying, “This place has become peaceful. It is time to help other planets as well.” Upon learning this, Sapana is shocked, but soon does the craziest thing imaginable and stops away on a a spaceship to meet Heroina.

Sapana’s spacecraft, on it’s way to the point where Heroina has gone, is struck by a meteorite and crash lands on a little blue planet called Earth. So in order to keep her identity a secret, he finds employ, jet at a construction site in order to make enough money to fix his ship. While working, Sapana finds a piece of bright meteorite that breaks in his hand and he accidentally absorbs the light, a small fragment of Heroina‘s power. Now, with this new found power, Sapana realizes he can actually change into Heroina’s appearance, but even more so, other people can absorb other fragments and do mischievous things with them, and even worse still; Heroina is actually inside these fragments and Sapana must find them all to put his heroine back together again.

title: I'll be Your Fan
description:
National star Seulchan An─leader of an idol group─has been able to maintain his position of top actor and show host through his handsome looks and quick judgment skills, instead of the skills he was given at age 18. Actress Yooni Kim has been stuck with extra roles ever since she scuffled with a major production agency due to her uncompromising nature; despite having a high level of skill, talent, and aspiration. A man who has everything but is no longer happy and a woman who has nothing but has a lot to protect, are slowly attracted to each other after they meet by pure coincidence. But there are too many obstacles for love to develop between the two, most notably the fans of Yooni (and her talent) and the broad-shouldered, narrow-minded agency CEO hell-bent on kicking Yooni out. The path to obtaining Yooni’s love is long and winding for Seulchan, even after swallowing his pride. title: Lady Action
description:
A woman with a dream to become a top director blackmails a guy from her past, now a superstar who was once a fat, geeky kid, in order to make her dream come true.

Yeon-jun is woman with a dream of becoming a film director in a world dominated by men. Driven towards obtaining the coveted director’s chair for a commercial film, she struggles against obstacles and name calling, until suddenly finding the solution to all her problems; the handsomely popular superstar named Do-hyun who she used to know when he was nothing but a fat, geeky wannabe.

Armed with this information, she approaches Do-hyun in order to blackmail him; either work for her as a star on this one film that’ll surely make her a success with his involvement, or suffer the consequences as she reveals to the world what he really used to look like when he was a child.

As she navigates her way around her first real film and deals with keeping Do-hyun in line, she also begins to succumb to his charms, all the while finding out other hardships that threaten to throw her, her film career and her budding relationship with someone she once used to loathe.

description:
"I wonder where she is, my other half..."Sunny Bong is a matchmaker who is about to be fired due to her lack of results. Her last chance is to match the Dujin, the general manager of Dudu Optics and heir of Dudu Company. However, Dujin possesses a special skill that is passed down in the family, and it is due to this that he has went on over five hundred blind dates and yet has never been matched. Sunny fails to match Dujin with the person he is looking for, and is fired from the company. One day later, after throwing a party with her roommate and friend Hana all night, she wakes up to find her friend gone, and the clue Hana left behind turns her life upside down. title: She Is Unique
description:
A young woman has a secret, she is actually half alien and feels like a recluse from the rest of the students until a young man takes notice of her and tries to win her over, showing her she is not a monster after all.

Byul, a freshman in space science university, gets caught up in bizarre rumors upon entering the school because she always wears a mask and never takes it off in public. So, there is an extreme rumors that she look like a monster under it.

Meanwhile, Min-sung, a simple-minded playboy, tries to dig up the secret behind the mask with his friend Seok-woo after feeling an unknown attraction to Byul, who’s usually lived alone without a friend, she ends up revealing her bare face at the goodwill of the two. Unexpectedly, Min-sung and Seok-woo keep her secret.

Byul seems to get over the crisis, but the secret is revealed when she realeases a sneeze that she was holding back and the mask falls on the table. Saliva melts the table which is actually hydrochloric acid and she reveals…

“My mother, she’s an Alien…”

People’s get surprised by the shocking fact and now Min-sung tries to stay away from Byul like if they were strangers. However, Min-sung continues to feel strangely attracted to Byul, and after many twists and turns, he becomes friends with her. Slowly their relationship developed into a strange romance, but their happiness faces a crisis as someone who wants everyone to know the existence of Byul appears.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4305420), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54296513)

title: Siwol Girl
description:
A fortuneteller and her guardian warrior travel 600 years from the past into the present in order to find a young woman who can stop an apocalyptic even from happening. Together, they must navigate high school and fight off monsters, magic and evil.

During the Chosun Dynasty, in the year 1562, the country’s fortuneteller, fled her beloved country trying to escape the wrath of the barbaric Yeojin by traveling through a mystical pond along with her guardian warrior, Kim Jang. Once on the other side, the duo realize that they are no longer in the Chosun era, but rather in 2007 Korea.

Fast forward to 2017, a young student named Yoon-sul meets a monster called Sheng Soo, who is responsible for having killed her father 10 years prior, but before the monster can hurt her too, the fortuneteller, who is now 16 year old, and her warrior Kim Jang, appear to assist her.

The fortuneteller asks Kim Jang to protect her and reveals that Yoon-sul is somehow connected by power to the monster and themselves. As it turns out the duo have been following her ever since her dad was killed so many years ago, looking for a way to interact. What they are just finding out however is that Yun Bong, the leader of the Yeonsinnae, used the pond to travel back with them and has been preparing to bring her army from the past to the present and use their magic to take over the world. Now they must work together to stop this from happening.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=4881120), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/56216990)

description:
A female student is enrolled in a school that is actually a secret hideout for nine tailed demon foxes.

On her first day of school, Yu-eun, who was wandering around the street because she couldn’t find her school, encountered a boy named Seo Il-hoo, who is actually a nine tailed fox Gumiho. She has no idea that this is what’s happening, but Sunwoon High School is actually a dangerous school full of Gumiho. The ratio of all school students is 10 percent Gumiho, and 90 percent humans. The foxes were using this method as a way to remove their traces from the exorcist who was tracking them down, so they mixed themselves up among humans and pretended to be ordinary students. The so-called Sunwoon High School is a perfect hiding place for Gumiho and a perfect place to easily hunt for the human spirit.

Seo Il-hoo, who finds out that Yu-eun is a human being but has the ability to see the them for who they are, puts her under his control and goes in for the hunt of her spirit. While there is a strange atmosphere between Il-hoo and Tae-shin surrounding Yu-eun, Baek-ryeon, the chairman of the board who brought Yu-eun to the school, tries to use Yu-eun, who turns out to be the great-granddaughter of the leader of the exorcist Jeong-ju, who was the only one who stood by and protected the Gumiho.

title: Stiletto
description:
Sometimes having many lives creates just as many heartbreaks.

Joon-hyung is a psychiatrist in a relationship with a fellow colleague, Lana. During his first day on the job, he encounters a rather peculiar patient named Hye-lim. She claims that she can leave her ‘vessel’ and be reborn anytime she wants. Joon-hyung diagnoses her with schizophrenia.

Hye-lim kills herself in front of Joon-hyung to prove that she is telling the truth. That evening, Joon-hyung gets a visit from Hye-lim, who had earlier killed herself. She is accompanied by a person named Yoo-sung. Yoo-sung explains to Joon-hyung that Hye-lim while she may look human that she is of a different species. These species have been handed down as ‘Property’ from one generation to another. They tend to crave affection of a third party and kill themselves if they fail – placing their owners in grief. The Owner and Property fall in love but it is Hye-lim’s nature to seek affection from a third party. Time passes and Hye-lim is ‘reborn’ and goes back to Joon-hyung, but her instinct to seek love elsewhere doesn’t change. This causes problems between Joon-hyung, his best friend Tae-hyun, and his ex-lover Lana. Emotional distress, jealousy and drama ensues.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=6557970), [KakaoPage](https://page.kakao.com/content/54116770)

title: Winter Fall
description:
22XX. A world where only the chosen ones are allowed to live in a city with umbrellas. Ahn, a resident outside the city, runs a cafe with his sickly son and lives a difficult life in extreme weather. Then one day, he finds out that his ID and health insurance, which he had prepared to cure his son's illness and start a new life, have been canceled. In order to restore the cancellation, he contacts a terrorist organization and heads to the Third City. After successfully completing his sniping mission to assassinate the target, Ahn meets Senator Enraque Giltare, a representative figure of the city for a certain minority and a government spokesman. The two, who seem to have no connection, had a brief encounter eight years ago, and the memory of that still lingers in Ahn's mind. However, the black hand of a terrorist organization reaches out to Ahn, who is trying to prepare a new future for his young son... 

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

*Note: Includes two extra chapters.*

title: Body Shade
description:
Simon Harper is a psychometry detective who can witness the moment of death by touching a corpse, but only through direct contact with the body itself. This peculiar method earns him a reputation as an eccentric, and work eventually dries up entirely. Resigned to giving up detective work and living an ordinary life, he one day receives a strange phone call: "My father is definitely dead, and yet he's still alive." Following this mysterious call, Simon accidentally touches the hand of a body brought into a hospital, only to realize it belongs to Frank Ferreira, the very much living president of a pharmaceutical company. From that moment on, a relentless series of bizarre incidents begins closing in around him… 

(Source: Naver, translated)
